name: with tidy ON, the periodic review's small non-destructive proposal applies itself as one undo, or a bigger one waits in to tidy (M263)

seed.content: Moving house: everything for the move in October
Call the movers for a quote
Get a quote from the moving company
Compare two moving companies on price
Books get packed before anything else
Change address for the electricity account
Grandmother's lasagna recipe: two layers of béchamel, bake 40 minutes

rounds.user: Also: forward the mail at the post office for six months, and tell the landlord the exact move-out date.
rounds.assistant: Added: mail forwarding for six months; landlord to be told the move-out date.

rounds.user: One more: the piano needs specialist movers — separate quote.
rounds.assistant: Noted: the piano needs specialist movers, quoted separately.

rounds.user: And book the elevator at the new building for the morning of the move.
rounds.assistant: Added: reserve the elevator at the new building for moving morning.
